name: Subdermal Plating
system: You gain one point of soak.

name: Wired Reflexes
system: You gain one rank of the Rapid Reflexes talent.

name: Direct Neural Interface
system: As a maneuver, you can directly jack into an unsupervised device that you are physically Engaged with to upgrade all Access Device matrix actions you make against the device once.

name: Cybernetic Perception
system: You gain one rank in the Perception skill.

name: Synthetic Circulatory System
system: You gain one rank in the Blooded talent

name: Bone Lacing
system: Your unarmed attacks gain one damage, they reduce their Critical rating to 3, and they lose the Nonlethal quality.

name: Smartlink
system: You can use the Smartgun System weapon attachment.

name: Carbon-fibre Muscles
system: You can increase the damage of your Brawl and Melee weapon attacks by one, and reduce their critical rating by one (to a minimum of 2).
